title: One Time landing WhatsApp launcher

reasons: The source explicitly asks to replace the One Time landing helper widget with a standard WhatsApp launcher.
The existing landing route still loads public helper scripts even though the action registry already has a public WhatsApp redirect action.
The work is public/app-visible and requires screenshot proof, action registry updates, and no-send guardrails.
likely_external_provider_blockers: ONE_TIME_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER must be configured at runtime before the link can open a live WhatsApp chat.
No WAPI/Whapi send, contact mutation, campaign send, payment/access change, DNS/provider write, or deploy is allowed in this packet.
recommended_packet_sequence: inspect served /one-time landing and public WhatsApp API
remove public helper scripts from /one-time only
add direct accessible WhatsApp launcher using same-origin redirect
update root action registry and tests
prove desktop/mobile landing screenshots and no external writes

operator_intent_summary: Replace the public One Time landing page's Robot Scheller/helper-widget entry with a standard WhatsApp bubble that uses the runtime-configured public WhatsApp number through the existing same-origin redirect and performs no server-side send.
raw_quotes: Replace landing helper widget with standard WhatsApp launcher.
The One Time landing page preserves the latest deployed design while replacing Robot Scheller/quick-command widget assets with an accessible WhatsApp bubble using runtime-configured public number.
No landing-only bna-bot-widget.js, bna-helper-knowledge.js, or Robot Scheller PNG load remains.
Launcher uses WhatsApp green circular bottom-right button with accessible label and focus state.
wa.me link uses ONE_TIME_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER and no client-side private credential/token.

The WhatsApp action registry still describes Robot Scheller/helper entry as part of the public landing.
No local screenshot smoke currently proves the direct landing WhatsApp launcher at desktop and mobile widths.

expanded_phrases.standard WhatsApp launcher: A fixed bottom-right circular WhatsApp-green link with the WhatsApp glyph/WA text, visible label for screen readers, focus state, and href to /api/one-time/public-whatsapp/redirect?intent=free_class.
expanded_phrases.preserves latest deployed design: Do not redesign the landing page sections, hero, forms, copy, or media; only remove the helper script/widget entry and add the launcher.
expanded_phrases.accessible: Launcher has a clear accessible name, focus-visible ring, target size at least 44 px, no overlap with form/dialog controls, and remains reachable on desktop and mobile.
expanded_phrases.runtime-configured public number: The browser only uses same-origin redirect/readiness URLs. The server reads ONE_TIME_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER or aliases at runtime and does not expose the full number in repo evidence.
expanded_phrases.configured: For this packet, configured means the runtime has a public WhatsApp number available to the server through ONE_TIME_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER or documented aliases; local proof may use a fake smoke-only number and must not commit or print the real value.
expanded_phrases.no-send: The launcher opens a user-initiated WhatsApp compose URL only; the server performs no WAPI/Whapi send or CRM mutation.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use the existing first-party /api/one-time/public-whatsapp readiness and redirect endpoints. Do not add GHL, LeadConnector, external CRM, WAPI send, or client-side secret configuration.

findings.user_impact: The public landing exposes the old helper-widget concept instead of the requested simple WhatsApp launcher.
findings.expected_fix: Remove landing helper scripts and render one direct WhatsApp launcher link.

findings.user_impact: The new launcher must be a named, target-sized link and not a decorative or ambiguous floating control.
findings.expected_fix: Add accessible name, focus state, fixed placement, and touch-safe dimensions.

requirements: WhatsApp launcher has an accessible name that includes WhatsApp and One Time.
Launcher is a link, not a fake button, and opens the same-origin redirect URL.
Launcher has a visible focus style with at least 3 px equivalent contrast.
Launcher target is at least 44 by 44 px on desktop and mobile.
Launcher does not overlap the signup modal, mobile nav, or required form controls.
No hidden helper panel or auto-open nudge steals focus.
